messages:
alex k: noticed p95 jump on /v1/generate in console but traces + gateway look normal. p50 steady, p99 up. anyone else seeing a sampling mismatch between console and metrics-api?
amira: do you mean event_time vs ingestion_time? we switched dashboard rollups to ingestion-window aggregation last month for stability.
tj: ingestion vs event_time has bitten us before for streaming endpoints. can you dump the queries you used?
alex k: minimal repro: console shows p99 ~1.8s for last 10m, metrics-api event_time p99 ~750ms. suspect retries are getting lumped into ingestion window causing tail inflation.
alex k: here's a quick query I ran against the internal metrics-api:
```
GET /internal/metrics/query
{
  "metric": "request_latency_ms",
  "filter": {"endpoint": "/v1/generate", "attempt": ["first", "retry"]},
  "group_by": ["attempt"],
  "window": {"type":"event_time","start":"-10m","end":"now"},
  "aggs": ["p50","p95","p99"]
}
```
amira: yep. console rollup pipeline merges samples by ingestion_time tumbling windows and drops attempt dimension at top-level to keep cardinality low. that explains the discrepancy.
lina: UX note: product wants a one-click "why is p99 high" for endpoints. suggestion: "split by attempt" + sample counts visible.
tj: also remember streaming vs immediate-response endpoints: tokenization/emit events sometimes create multiple latency samples per request if instrumentation is event-based. alignment matters.
metrics-bot: exported 10m sample for /v1/generate: first attempt -> p95=210ms, p99=780ms (n=120k); retry -> p95=450ms, p99=2.1s (n=3.2k).
lina: so retries are rare but very high tail — ingestion-window merge magnifies their effect on p99 at dashboard level. if retries align with large ingestion buckets, tail looks worse.
amira: implementation considerations: we can either (A) compute top-level p50/p95/p99 from event_time rollups, or (B) keep ingestion rollups but surface "contributors" that show per-attempt percentiles and counts so users can filter. (A) needs storage for per-tenant event_time rollups or on-the-fly comp; (B) needs additional indexed dims.
alex k: proposed product compromise: default console percentiles should use event_time rollup; add a small "ingestion view" toggle for debugging. also add hover breakdown: attempt / region / model-variant with counts.
tj: SRE ops: add an alert classification — if p99 spikes but retry_count contribution < 2% of samples, mark as "retry-induced" and suppress paging to reduce noise.
amira: rough cost estimate: maintaining event_time rollups per tenant ~ +6% storage and +10% compute on rollup pipeline. on-the-fly aggregation for drilldowns only would add CPU but little storage.
alex k: can someone file an infra ticket and mark as pctl-telemetry-high? this is affecting SLO alert noise.
tj: I filed INFR-3289 with query samples, metrics export, and mock UX screenshots. assigned to amira.
amira: I'll scope the rollup changes and propose a plan (fast path: add contributor breakdown + sample-count badges; medium: event_time rollups for top-level). looping in @eng-sre and @product for alert/UX decisions.
opsbot: scheduled meeting: telemetry sync tomorrow 10:30am PT (invite sent). :calendar:
alex k: thanks all. if we can get contributor breakdown in next console patch it's probably enough to reduce confusion. :thumbsup:
